about: One map of the Authentication settings an environment can hold. Read by src/control/auth-config.ts and checked against lab/auth_settings.py by lab/test_auth_config_registry.py. Key names are the platform config names the pinned Studio carries (docs/evidence/auth-config-study-2026-10-30/study.json); each becomes the GOTRUE_ variable of the same name. A key has one owner file. A default is listed only where this repository sets it; JWT_EXP has none here (the pinned Auth applies its own), so it shows null_text.

core.label: Allow manual linking
core.evidence: json tag manual_linking_enabled with default false in the pinned Auth binary (SecurityConfiguration)

core.label: Allow new users to sign up
Enforce single session per user
core.hint: If enabled, all but a user's most recently active session will be terminated.
core.evidence: json tag single_per_user in the pinned Auth binary

core.label: Detect and revoke potentially compromised refresh tokens
core.hint: Prevent replay attacks from potentially compromised refresh tokens.
core.evidence: json tag refresh_token_rotation_enabled in the pinned Auth binary; default true in the same binary tag

core.label: Refresh token reuse interval
core.hint: Time interval where the same refresh token can be used multiple times to request for an access token. Recommendation: 10 seconds. Maximum 300 seconds (5 minutes).
core.evidence: json tag refresh_token_reuse_interval in the pinned Auth binary

core.label: Rate limit for token refreshes
core.hint: Number of sessions that can be refreshed in a 5 minute interval per IP address
core.evidence: env name string GOTRUE_RATE_LIMIT_TOKEN_REFRESH in the pinned Auth binary

core.label: Rate limit for anonymous users
core.hint: Number of anonymous sign-ins that can be made per hour per IP address
core.evidence: env name string RATE_LIMIT_ANONYMOUS_USERS in the pinned Auth binary

core.label: Rate limit for Web3 sign-ups and sign-ins
core.hint: Number of Web3 sign-up or sign-in requests that can be made per IP address in 5 minutes
core.evidence: env name string RATE_LIMIT_WEB3 in the pinned Auth binary

core.label: Prevent use of leaked passwords
core.hint: Rejects the use of known or easy to guess passwords on sign up or password change. Auth checks the Have I Been Pwned range service, so this environment gets outbound network access while it is on.
core.evidence: HIBP structures in the pinned Auth binary; the name PASSWORD_HIBP_ENABLED comes from the Studio schema only

core.label: Minimum password length
core.hint: Passwords shorter than this are rejected on sign up and password change. Auth hashes at most 72 bytes of a password, so the highest value is 72.
core.evidence: json tag min_length in the pinned Auth binary; the name PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH comes from the Studio schema only. Maximum 72: the bcrypt limit, not read from the binary.

core.label: Maximum number of per-user MFA factors
core.hint: How many MFA factors can be enrolled at once per user.
core.evidence: MaxEnrolledFactors split_words default 10 in the pinned Auth binary

core.label: Allow people to add an authenticator app (TOTP)
core.hint: Turn this off to stop new TOTP factors being enrolled. Existing factors keep working while verification stays on.
core.evidence: json tag enroll_enabled in the pinned Auth binary; default true in the same binary tag

core.label: Allow people to verify with an authenticator app (TOTP)
core.hint: Turn this off to stop TOTP codes being accepted. Use with care: people who rely on them cannot pass a second factor.
core.evidence: json tag verify_enabled in the pinned Auth binary; default true in the same binary tag
